primary_link.title: Forget Attention: Importance-Aware Attention Is All You Need

We propose SISA (SSM-Informed Softmax Attention), which adds an SSM-deriv
papers.summary_zh: 結合注意力機制的全局檢索與狀態空間模型（SSM）的順序重要性信號是混合語言建模的開放挑戰。現有混合模型如Jamba（塊級）和Hymba（頭級）將兩者置於分離的模組中，導致注意力計算時彼此無法互相融合。本文提出SISA（SSM-Informed Softmax Attention），通過將SSM衍生的重要性分數直接調製softmax注意力權重，使注意力既能看見所有內容又能優先聚焦重要資訊。這一體化設計實現了注意力與SSM在計算層面的深度協同，有望為混合模型帶來更強的長序列建模和推理性能。

links.title: What You Approve Is What Executes: Consent Integrity for Black-Box LLM Agents

primary_link.title: What You Approve Is What Executes: Consent Integrity for Black-Box LLM Agents

papers.summary: Coding agents gate consequential actions behind a human-in-the-loop approval dialog, but the dialog is narrated by the agent itself: the human approves a summary the agent writes. The Lies-in-the-Loop (LITL) attack shows that summary is forgeable, so a compromised agent can show a benign description while a different action runs. papers.summary_zh: 編碼代理將重要操作置於人在回路中的批准對話之後，但對話敘述由代理自身編寫，攻擊表明批准摘要可偽造，從而展示無害描述卻執行惡意動作。本文引入同意完整性概念，借鑒「所見即所簽」（WYSIWYS）和可信路徑原則，為代理批准鏈設計一組屬性，確保使用者核准的內容與最終執行的動作完全一致。該工作為保護使用者在無法透視代理內部邏輯時的安全交互，提供了理論框架與檢測方法。
papers.title: What You Approve Is What Executes: Consent Integrity for Black-Box LLM Agents

radar.summary_zh: 基於 LLM 的智慧體可透過結合推理與環境反饋解決多步驟互動任務，但每個回合從相同固定上下文開始，過程中發現的有用策略在任務結束後即丟失。現有方法要么將學習限制在當前任務，要么將所有經驗匯入單一未分類儲存庫，缺乏知識類型區分、品質追踪及庫中缺失平衡。本文提出 Unified Context Evolution，透過統一上下文進化機制，跨任務保留並重用策略知識，提升智慧體長期表現。
radar.title: Unified Context Evolution for LLM Agents
radar.title_zh: LLM 智慧體的統一上下文進化

links.title: SeClaw: Spec-Driven Security Task Synthesis for Evaluating Autonomous Agents

primary_link.title: SeClaw: Spec-Driven Security Task Synthesis for Evaluating Autonomous Agents

radar.summary: Autonomous LLM agents increasingly operate in stateful environments where they access tools, files, memory, and external services. radar.summary_zh: 自主 LLM 智慧體日益在有狀態環境中運行，存取工具、檔案、記憶體與外部服務。此類能力雖支援複雜真實工作流程，也引入現有評估難以捕捉的安全風險。當前智慧體安全基準多依賴人工策劃任務，對新興威脅覆蓋有限，且主要關注最終結果而非導致不安全行為的執行過程。本文提出 SeClaw，一種規範驅動的安全任務合成方法，能系統性地生成多元安全評估場景。
radar.title: SeClaw: Spec-Driven Security Task Synthesis for Evaluating Autonomous Agents
radar.title_zh: SeClaw：用於評估自主智慧體的規範驅動安全任務合成

links.title: POIROT: Interrogating Agents for Failure Detection in Multi-Agent Systems

primary_link.title: POIROT: Interrogating Agents for Failure Detection in Multi-Agent Systems

radar.summary: Orchestrating Large Language Models into Multi-Agent Systems (LLM-MAS) has unlocked remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet emergent failures and hallucinations that resist characterisation block their deployment in safety-critical domains -- a gap made legally untenable by emerging AI regulation. radar.summary_zh: 將大型語言模型編排為多智慧體系統展現了卓越的推理能力，但新興故障與幻覺難以表徵，阻礙其在安全關鍵領域的部署——新興 AI 法規更使此缺口在法律上難以容忍。現有評估典範共享一個缺陷：集中式判斷產生單點故障，並需要領域特定專業知識。本文提出 POIROT，一個重複利用系統中其他智慧體進行交叉審問的協議，實現分散式故障檢測，提升系統可靠性。
radar.title: POIROT: Interrogating Agents for Failure Detection in Multi-Agent Systems
radar.title_zh: POIROT：在多智慧體系統中審問智慧體以進行故障檢測

links.title: ResMerge: Residual-based Spectral Merging of Large Language Models

primary_link.title: ResMerge: Residual-based Spectral Merging of Large Language Models

radar.summary: Model merging offers a training-free way to combine multiple post-trained expert models, but merging experts obtained through reinforcement learning (RL) remains challenging. radar.summary_zh: 模型合併提供了一種無需訓練即可組合多個後訓練專家模型的方法，但合併透過強化學習獲得的專家仍具挑戰。現有頻譜合併方法常假設主導奇異方向包含主要任務訊號，而低能量殘餘分量可壓縮、選擇或衰減以減少干擾。本文發現此假設對 RL 任務向量不成立：在將每個任務向量分解為主導與殘差分量的實驗中，殘差分量包含重要的任務特異資訊，需要特殊處理以實現有效合併。
radar.title: ResMerge: Residual-based Spectral Merging of Large Language Models
radar.title_zh: ResMerge：基於殘差的語言模型頻譜合併

primary_link.title: Cross-Environment Neural Reranking for Sample-Efficient Action Selection in Text-Based Agents

radar.summary: Large language model agents achieve strong performance on text-based benchmarks but incur prohibitive inference costs, motivating the use of compact neural rerankers for action selection. radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型智慧體在文字型基準測試中表現強勁，但推論成本高昂，促使研究者使用輕量神經重排序器進行行動選擇。本文探討單一輕量模型能否跨多個不同環境執行行動選擇，此能力將消除每個環境單獨維護模型的需求。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 與 ScienceWorld 上聯合訓練 DeBERTa-v3（1.84億-4.34億參數），並採用少數類別上取樣，結果顯示跨環境訓練可行且高效。
radar.title: Cross-Environment Neural Reranking for Sample-Efficient Action Selection in Text-Based Agents
radar.title_zh: 跨環境神經重排序：文字型智慧體中樣本高效的行動選擇

links.title: InfoMerge: Information-aware Token Compression for Efficient Video Large Language Models

primary_link.title: InfoMerge: Information-aware Token Compression for Efficient Video Large Language Models

radar.summary: Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) achieve strong performance in video understanding, but their excessive visual tokens bring substantial computational overhead. Existing training-free compression methods improve inference efficiency by reducing visual tokens, yet they often rely on local adjacent-frame similarity for temporal redundancy estimation or allocate token budgets mainly according to segment length. radar.summary_zh: 視覺大語言模型在影片理解上表現優異，但過多的視覺令牌帶來巨大計算開銷。現有無訓練壓縮方法透過減少視覺令牌提升推論效率，但它們常依賴局部相鄰幀相似性估計時間冗餘，或主要根據片段長度分配令牌預算。此類設計對幀級噪聲敏感，且未能捕捉非均勻的資訊分佈。本文提出 InfoMerge，一種資訊感知的令牌壓縮方法，根據全局資訊量動態分配預算，在保持性能的同時顯著降低計算成本。
radar.title: InfoMerge: Information-aware Token Compression for Efficient Video Large Language Models
radar.title_zh: InfoMerge：資訊感知的視覺語言模型令牌壓縮

radar.summary: Dictionary learning with sparse autoencoders (SAEs) produces overcomplete bases from neural network activations that are often interpretable and reduces polysemanticity. radar.summary_zh: 使用稀疏自編碼器的字典學習從神經網路激活中產生過完備基，這些基常具有可解釋性並減少多義性。然而不同隨機種子下的 SAE 特徵差異很大——稱為不穩定性問題。原型 SAE 被提出作為更可靠概念提取的通用字典學習干預，並報告訓練結束時字典更穩定。本文證明該穩定性主要源於特定的初始化策略與評估指標設計，而非方法本身的本質優勢。

links.title: PlanarBench: Evaluating LLM Spatial Reasoning via Planar Graph Drawing

primary_link.title: PlanarBench: Evaluating LLM Spatial Reasoning via Planar Graph Drawing

radar.summary:
PlanarBench tests whether LLMs can draw planar graphs as ASCII art given only an edge list -- a spatial reasoning task that resists memorization because edge order, edge orientation, and node labels are all permutable.

  Edge count is the dominant difficulty predictor ($r = -0.85$) -- a finding not reported in prior LLM graph benchmarks, which use only node count as the difficulty axis.
radar.summary_zh: PlanarBench 測試 LLM 能否僅給定邊列表以 ASCII 藝術繪製平面圖——這是一個抗拒記憶化的空間推理任務，因為邊順序、邊方向與節點標籤均可置換。作者在 199 個最簡單的非同構連通平面圖（2-7 個頂點）上評估了 91 個模型。邊數是主要的難度預測因子（r = -0.85），此發現未在先前僅以節點數作為難度軸的 LLM 圖形基準中報告。
radar.title: PlanarBench: Evaluating LLM Spatial Reasoning via Planar Graph Drawing
radar.title_zh: PlanarBench：透過平面圖繪製評估 LLM 空間推理

links.title: CultureForest: Understanding and Evaluating Cultural Norm Grounded Reasoning in LLMs

primary_link.title: CultureForest: Understanding and Evaluating Cultural Norm Grounded Reasoning in LLMs

radar.summary: Existing research largely reduces cultural intelligence in LLMs to a knowledge-level problem, overlooking whether models can effectively utilize their acquired knowledge in realistic scenarios. radar.summary_zh: 現有研究大多將 LLM 的文化智能簡化為知識層級問題，忽略模型能否在真實場景中有效運用所學知識。為填補此缺口，本文引入 CultureForest，一個用於文化規範基礎推理的基準。每個問題基於一小組原子規範，從而實現可驗證與可歸因的評估。CultureForest 包含 5,378 個範例，涵蓋 8 個領域與 53 個國家/地區，支援細粒度分析模型的文化規範理解與推理能力。
radar.title: CultureForest: Understanding and Evaluating Cultural Norm Grounded Reasoning in LLMs
radar.title_zh: CultureForest：理解與評估 LLM 中的文化規範基礎推理

links.title: ContinuousBench: Can Differentially Private Synthetic Text Improve Capabilities?

primary_link.title: ContinuousBench: Can Differentially Private Synthetic Text Improve Capabilities?

radar.summary: Differentially private (DP) text synthesis promises to unlock sensitive corpora for model training, but it remains unclear whether DP synthetic data transmits genuinely new knowledge and capabilities present only in those corpora. radar.title: ContinuousBench: Can Differentially Private Synthetic Text Improve Capabilities?
radar.title_zh: ContinuousBench：差分隱私合成文字能否改善能力？

links.title: Rethinking the Role of Positional Encoding: Sliding-Window Transformers without PE Remain Turing Complete

primary_link.title: Rethinking the Role of Positional Encoding: Sliding-Window Transformers without PE Remain Turing Complete

top5.summary: Positional encoding (PE) is widely viewed as necessary for transformers to process ordered sequences: without them, the next-token map appears permutation-invariant in its context tokens. top5.title: Rethinking the Role of Positional Encoding: Sliding-Window Transformers without PE Remain Turing Complete
top5.title_zh: 重新審視位置編碼的角色：無PE的滑動窗口Transformer仍具圖靈完備性

links.title: ProbMoE: Differentiable Probabilistic Routing for Mixture-of-Experts

primary_link.title: ProbMoE: Differentiable Probabilistic Routing for Mixture-of-Experts

top5.title: The Ringelmann Effect in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: A Scaling Law for Effective Team Size
top5.title_zh: 多智能體LLM系統中的林格曼效應：有效團隊規模的標度律

links.title: AlphaToken: Decoupling Adaptation and Stability for Path-Aware Response Token Valuation in LLM Post-Training

primary_link.title: AlphaToken: Decoupling Adaptation and Stability for Path-Aware Response Token Valuation in LLM Post-Training
